Olga Alekseevna Pavlova (called Origa in the story event) is an assassin of the UFS.

She is the last main story capture and "Final Boss" of Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena introduction prologue.


Personality
Very down to business, she enjoys the pain she can inflict with her ability and definitely has a sadistic and criminal side to her. In the past had the dream of becoming a dancer, but after she was forced to kill her father, she became twisted and gave up on those dreams.

She works for the UFS to pay off a multiple life sentence, nothing more, but still holds love for her sister. Olga no longer trusts people after being betrayed by her lover. She is unscrupulous and fearless.

Appearance
She has long white hair, dark red eyes. Has a voluptuous body all around but still on the medium size all things considered (even if she's trending towards the large body size). She wears a full body black suit that further emphasizes her body type and leaves little to the imagination by how tight it looks to be. Her outfit has some greenish blue and deep crimson lines/objects in it. She carries a pair of daggers.

History
Background
Human, Russian assassin, born year 2060.

She has a sick sister called Misha , and had a normal happy childhood, but when Olga was 15 and Misha was 10, around the year 2075, their father's business failed, and they fell into misery. The father was a drunkard and their mother, fed up with him, leaves him and her two daughters. Olga had to give up on her dream of becoming a ballerina to work, and her little sister, Misha, is struck with a serious illness. Misha's medication becomes more and more expensive, and her health deteriorates further. One time when her father becomes drunk and violently attacks Misha, Olga tries to protect her and awakens to her powers. She kills his father when she puts her hands inside her father's body and stops his heart with both hands. Since then, she has entered the dark side of the world.

She has assassinated numerous politicians and powerful men, and even found a lover, but was sold out to the UFS by him. Her sentence came down to 777 years in prison, and her sick sister Misha was used as a hostage, so she was forced to work for a reduced sentence and her sister is kept as a guarantee to keep her from running away.

Timeline TABA
She was part of the main raid on Fuuma Kotaro's base in the year 2082. She lost after being affected by Fuuma's ability and has been mind broken into one of his soldiers.

Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Two Daggers

Dive: Has the ability of Intangibility (Phasing). She is able to dive through solid matter of any type, able to pass into the body of other people to kill them.
Knife Sleeve: Can hide her daggers in her sleeves.
Assassin Training: Stated to be a very deadly and effective assassin. Capable of using her ability and her daggers to kill her victims in creative ways while escaping with impunity.
Media
Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena
Taimanin RPGX (Recollection Gallery)
Trivia
Her name implies that she was originally from Russia.
She worked as an assassin for UFS to pay off a 777-year prison sentence.
As the last capture of the main story mode, she is technically the Final Boss. However, most of the story in Arena is told via events.
Additional information is given in TABA Artbook 1.
As it is not stated what her ability is and if it is a Taimanin one or of a different nature, she will be considered as an Esper.
